text_block_list.text:
Transcend's life's work: interacting with 
all kinds of people in various places.

"We came out to volunteer for a coastal 
clean-up today. Transcend often takes part 
in local volunteer activities."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I am the star... I am the star... I gotta 
get used to being the lead on a daily 
basis..."

text_block_list.name: Volunteer Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, now let's decide on a leader. The 
person taking charge of the cleanup this 
time will be...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Me, me! I volunteer! After all, I'm 
right in the middle of my main character 
arc!

text_block_list.name: Friend from Volunteering
text_block_list.text:
T-Tran-chan, are you okay~? You always 
said you didn't really like standing out, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Hehehe, I'll show you a 
side of me you've never seen.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, everyone. It's true that this 
cleanup will be tough. The amount of trash 
is incomparable to usual.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, as long as you follow my 
instructions, you'll be fine! Just follow 
my lead!

text_block_list.name: Volunteers
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

To get used to being in the spotlight as 
the lead, Transcend volunteered to take on 
the role of leader. And then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Oooone, twoooo, threeee... Making sure 
not to miss every nook and cranny."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is great~. Just quietly picking 
up trash. Losing track of time, totally 
absorbed...
choice_data_list:
Tran, you're forgetting your duties as 
leader!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Leader? Ah, right! I totally forgot to 
give orders...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Everyone's just cleaning in whatever 
random direction they feel like!? Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufun-fu~. Starting today, I'm the big 
boss of these backstreets, so treat me 
well~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Stop treating me like an informant 
already. Underestimate me and I'll wipe 
you out, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Bald Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Transcend! We got trouble! My pet 
Nyoro-chan escaped!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nyoro-chan did!? But she's always so 
affectionate with me~! Oh no, this is 
terrible!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, let me ask my friend in Africa right 
now! Um, ball pythons! Places ball pythons 
would like...
choice_data_list:
The Big Boss herself... is going to search 
for a pet?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Gwah, that's true, but... she's just so 
darn cute, that girl!

text_block_list.name: Parishioner Man
text_block_list.text:
What was that!? I told you, there's no way 
in hell we're moving that grave!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, fellow parishioners. Please, 
restrain yourselves for my sake as your 
coordinator.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So I prepared a reconciliation banquet, 
and I hope everyone enjoys it peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Parishioner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you, Tran-chan. Sorry to trouble 
you every time...
choice_data_list:
Aren't you the party organizer instead of 
the guest of honor?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shoot... I ended up doing chores out 
of habit...

No matter what I do, nothing goes right. 
Before I knew it, I had gone from being 
the leader to working behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everything up to now was just a dress 
rehearsal! Just a rehearsal. The real 
thing starts next.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For the upcoming autumn's Holy Hoof 
Festival... our class is going to put on a 
play, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up getting the lead role. With 
everyone watching, I'm gonna own that 
stage, so just watch me."
choice_data_list: The lead in the play, huh? Yeah, good luck

The lead in the play, huh? Yeah, do your 
best

text_block_list.text:
—The Holy Hoof Festival. If she can give a 
splendid performance as the lead on a 
stage packed with spectators, it will 
surely give her a huge boost of 
confidence.
And on the day of the dress rehearsal—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey. I'm Little Red Riding Hood. Well, 
today's just rehearsal, so it's a red 
jersey for now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm going on an errand to Grandma's house 
now. Alright, let's do this!

Transcend seemed to be in slightly higher 
spirits than usual, too. Perhaps an 
awareness of becoming the lead star was 
gradually beginning to sprout within her.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's Grandmother's house over 
there.
(Bang, rattle, crash!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what was that loud noise?! Was that 
in the script?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, ma'am?!
Transcend bursts into the house. And then—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Cut the crap. I told you to just stay 
quiet and let yourself get eaten, you old 
hag!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wolves are the strongest! I'm gonna 
swallow up every last dirt Umamusume 
whole!

Playing the wolf is Espoir City. Having 
already debuted, she's a rebellious gyaru 
rapidly making a name for herself on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
At first, I expected to be eaten. But when 
it comes to "in a race too," I can't let 
that happen.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"My hometown, Funabashi, that raised me... 
To prove its strength—I can't lose, not 
ever."

And playing the grandma was Furioso. She's 
a dirt powerhouse too, and loves her 
hometown Funabashi more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Tables turned, Mr. Wolf! I'll show you 
what Funabashi is made of!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The greatness of Funabashi!? Why on earth 
is an old fairy-tale lady pushing 
Funabashi so hard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's a showdown then! Who's the 
strongest—me, or the old lady from 
Funabashi?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, just what I wanted. —Come at me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Eeeeeh...? What is this skit? 
Rowdy Wolf vs. Funabashi Grandma?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Take this, the passionate heartbeat of 
Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, hey, hey! Don't go putting on an 
entertaining show with just the two of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just calm down~ Trainy, stop them, stop 
them!
choice_data_list:
Alright, alright, that's enough! Stop the 
battle, stop it!

text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly stepped in to mediate. By 
occasionally stepping in to keep things in 
check, the actual performance was a 
success, but...

Transcend's days of hard effort continue. 
Step by step, aiming to be the 
protagonist, she climbed the stairs.
